Mezzanine master

Definition

Mezzanine master is a high-quality intermediate master designed for reliable creation of multiple distribution encodes. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align delivery decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
